The '''''River Queen''''' is a river ship. No mention is made of the names of the captain or any of the crew.

==Activities==
The ''River Queen'' traveled the [[Erinin River]] from [[Tar Valon]] to [[Medo]] and back.{{ref/book|2|12}} The ''Queen'' carried the [[Amyrlin Seat|Amyrlin]] [[Siuan Sanche]] and her party to Medo, where they then traveled to [[Fal Dara]] in [[Shienar]]. After meeting with [[Rand al'Thor]], the Amyrlin's party returned to Medo and sailed back to Tar Valon with [[Egwene al'Vere]] and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]].{{ref/book|2|18}}
